rationale: French blood storage cyber-attack continues EU infrastructure threats; US midterm results may indirectly affect EU economy; Brazil fossil fuel roadmap continues as background; no direct impact on Portuguese daily life.

top_events.title: French blood storage impacted by freezer hacks as theories swirl about culprits
top_events.label: Cyber-attack hits French blood storage facilities
top_events.summary: Hackers targeted French blood storage cold rooms, part of coordinated EU infrastructure attacks. The threat affects multiple EU countries including Portugal.

top_events.title: Brazil publishes first global 'roadmap' for phasing out fossil fuels
top_events.label: Brazil releases global fossil fuel phase-out roadmap
top_events.summary: Brazil published steps for countries to break dependence on coal, oil and gas. The roadmap may influence EU energy policy and Portugal's transition plans.

top_events.title: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat
top_events.label: Democrats win US Congress in midterm elections
top_events.summary: Democrats took control of Congress in US midterms. The shift may indirectly affect EU trade and economic relations with Portugal.

short_summary: Spain transport minister resigns after crash

most_significant_event.label: Spain transport minister resigns after crash
most_significant_event.summary: At least 69 people killed and dozens injured in train collision south of Madrid; minister resigns. Major tragedy in neighboring Iberian country.
most_significant_event.title: Spanish transport minister resigns days after deadly train crash
